how_to_execute: Run `/next` with no argument and it picks the first pending task whose dependencies are met. TASK-001 and TASK-002 are independent and may run concurrently. TASK-003 is ONE agent with procedures/TASK-003.md verbatim; the session that launches it must not have the shipped PCR-005 open in the same context. TASK-004 is a HARD STOP: it ends the turn with A.pdf/B.pdf ready and D4 open, and resumes only when the owner's reading arrives; the reading is written down before anything is counted. On D4 = FAIL, TASK-006..TASK-010 are cancelled and TASK-005, TASK-011, TASK-012 still run. On PASS, TASK-006, TASK-007 and TASK-009 are independent of each other; TASK-008 waits on TASK-006 (the guide's tic list must match GATED); TASK-010 waits on TASK-007 and TASK-005; TASK-009 has its own HALT for the owner's read of the eight mechanism files.
